name: Ano Hi no Kimi ni Koi o Shite ~Moto Kare Paradise~
original_name: あの日の君に恋をして～元カレパラダイス～
source:
After graduating from community college, you obtained your nursery teacher’s license and began working at a nursery in the city that your community college introduced you to.
Your daily life passes you by without anything changing between yesterday and today.
You feel there is nothing ‘flowery’ about your life since not only have you not been in any relationships lately, but you have barely talked to any men.
“But even I have—“
You have had an average love life until now.
You recall the days you spent with your ‘Ex-boyfriends’.
You feel nothing but regret about how things turned out, but there’s nothing you can do about it now. But, one day, something happens that greatly changes your fate. It happened on your way home from the train station.

[from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.motokarekaigai]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
从社区大学毕业后，你获得了托儿所教师执照，并开始在社区大学向你介绍的城市的托儿所工作。
你的日常生活从昨天到今天没有任何改变。
你觉得你的生活没有什么“华丽”的，因为你最近不仅没有任何恋爱关系，而且你几乎没有和任何男人说过话。
“但即使是我也——”
到目前为止，你的爱情生活很一般。
你回想起与“前男友”一起度过的日子。
你对事情的结果只感到遗憾，但现在却无能为力。但是，有一天，发生了一件事，极大地改变了你的命运。事情发生在你从火车站回家的路上。
